page: Microsoft Azure EC4eds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECEDV6 family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 236 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not feature any graphics processing units.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 provides resource density for memory-bound workloads without requiring the provisioning of excess compute cores. The inclusion of local storage offers a built-in storage option, reducing the immediate necessity for external disk attachments. This configuration is designed for workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching, and data analytics tasks that require a larger memory footprint relative to processing cores.
